intent: Implement opt-in stall-v1 over the existing bounded allocation: hash completed SDK action/error/output pairs and bounded tracked/staged/untracked progress, issue one durable fixed diagnostic with run=false, then fence the original namespace on continued loops or uncertain delivery. Preserve attempt identity, request reservations, unknown completion semantics and default profile; never create a second conversation, resume automatically, refund or replay effects.

findings.suggested_fix: Carry a durable cursor for all inspected SDK observations and account for every newly completed result before classifying a repeated failure. If current workspace state cannot be attributed to skipped historical results, conservatively clear the detection window whenever those skipped results include a successful investigation or changed diagnostic evidence instead of treating sampled failures as consecutive. Add an integration regression with error/poll, then unique successful diagnostic plus same error/poll repeated at least four times; it must neither intervene nor fence.
findings.title: Sampling hides new diagnostics and fences productive work
findings.why_it_matters: Each poll discards all completed observations except the latest one. If a successful read yields new diagnostic evidence and is followed by the same failing command before the next poll, the detector sees only identical errors. Four such polls incorrectly issue the diagnostic; three more can fence a productive investigation and leave partial effects requiring reconciliation. This violates the conservative productive-read/new-evidence requirement even though all events are present in the fetched history.
findings.validation_reason: In the frozen 60c4296-based reviewed snapshot, distinct successful diagnostic reads followed by the same failed command between successive polls are reachable through StallAdapter._sample, but latest_sample discards each read and run_session forwards only identical failures; read-only reproductions produced intervention at poll4 and stop at poll7 despite fresh diagnostic evidence before every repeat, while live incidence was not measured.
